description: Defines the ImageHeader struct for PNG images within the PDFsharp library, including image properties and validation logic.

classes.name: ImageHeader
classes.description: A readonly struct representing high-level PNG image information, including dimensions, color type, bit depth, and methods for validation and string representation.

methods.name: ImageHeader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an ImageHeader instance with validation for width, height, and bit depth based on color type.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string summarizing the image header properties.
